deals.headline: RedBird Capital makes significant investment in Fenway Sports Group
deals.summary: RedBird invested in Red Sox parent FSG at a $7.35bn enterprise valuation; LeBron James, Maverick Carter and Paul Wachter exchanged a Liverpool interest into FSG and Sam Kennedy converted incentive interests into FSG equity. Deal closed March 31, 2021.

deals.evidence: It also bought a piece of Fenway Sports Group, whose assets include the Boston Red Sox
deals.headline: Arctos buys a piece of Fenway Sports Group
deals.summary: Among Arctos's early investments was a stake in Fenway Sports Group, parent of the Red Sox; Sportico counts the Red Sox among six MLB teams Arctos had invested in by early 2022. No size or date stated.

notes: Forbes estimate: price paid $380M in 2002 (Forbes team page); revenue/operating income for the 2025 season net of revenue sharing and stadium debt service; debt/value 5%. Dynasty Equity's 2023 and 1892 Holdings' 2026 minority investments were in Liverpool FC, not FSG, so are excluded. ownership_summary: Owned by Fenway Sports Group (formerly New England Sports Ventures), the Henry-Werner group that bought the club in 2002; John W. Henry is principal owner and Tom Werner chairman. RedBird Capital Partners invested in FSG in March 2021 at a $7.35bn FSG enterprise valuation, and Arctos Partners also holds a piece of FSG.
